mapper.select: SELECT MAX(sd.price) AS maxPrice, MIN(sd.price) AS minPrice, sd.sku_id, COUNT(sd.sku_id) AS count, round( SUM (sd.price*qty ) / sum(sd.qty), 2 ) avgPrice FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE is_deleted=FALSE AND si.approve_status=#{approveStatus} AND sku_id!='' and qty!=0 GROUP BY sku_id

SELECT sd.id, sd.main_id, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, sd.qty, sd.is_gift, sd.is_close, sd.remark, sd.delivery_status, si.approve_status FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted=FALSE
